acceptance_criteria.description: PilotAuthorizationGate defaults to Disabled (OfflineSimulator) on startup and in all automated test suites, preserving SimulatorRobotTransport and OFFLINE badge.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-401, TEST-PILOT-402: DefaultAppContainer boots in OfflineDefault with zero network I/O.

acceptance_criteria.description: Authorized pilot sessions require explicit PilotAuthorizationContext with non-empty authorizationId, readOnlyMode = true, bounded observationWindowMs, and exact endpoint config.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-401: Missing or non-read-only PilotAuthorizationContext rejected fail-closed before any network call.

acceptance_criteria.description: AuthorizedPilotEndpointTrustPolicy restricts auth to exact grit-cloud.(cn|com) /prod/oauth origins and validates dynamic api_url/wss_url against pinned or human-confirmed https/wss :443 origins.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-403: Rejects unpinned unconfirmed origins, wildcards, cleartext schemes, non-443 ports, and 3xx redirects.

acceptance_criteria.description: validateResolvedAddresses rejects loopback, link-local/metadata, RFC1918 private, multicast, and unspecified IPs while enforcing Proxy.NO_PROXY and followRedirects(false).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-403: Synthetic DNS test proves 127.0.0.1, 10.0.0.1, 172.16.0.1, 192.168.1.1, 169.254.169.254, ::1, and fe80::1 are blocked before connect.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot OkHttpClient uses standard Android platform TLS 1.2/1.3 TrustManager and HostnameVerifier, failing closed on SSLHandshakeException with zero trust-all or global SSL overrides.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-404: TLS hygiene & static source scan verify zero trust-all verifiers or global SSL mutations and fail-closed handshake rejection.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot auth probe records sanitized protocol metadata and aborts immediately on ChallengeRequired (UNK-AUTH-04) without CAPTCHA bypass.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-405: MockWebServer challenge response maps cleanly to AuthFailureReason.ChallengeRequired and aborts pilot.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot auth uses Utf8TlsDefault exclusively (UNK-AUTH-05) and aborts to ProtocolMismatchAbort on rejection without silently switching to legacy MD5.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-405: MockWebServer rejection verifies zero MD5 fallback dispatch and fail-closed abort.

acceptance_criteria.description: Opt-in pilot sign-in UI uses mutable CharArray secret input (PasswordVisualTransformation, autoCorrectEnabled=false), wipes CharArray in finally, and retains zero plaintext password in ViewModel.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-406: Robolectric Compose test verifies CharArray zeroed post-dispatch and ViewModel state holds zero password.

acceptance_criteria.description: KeystoreAeadTokenStore persists only PersistedSessionRecord via AndroidKeyStore AES-256-GCM while SessionCoordinator preserves conservative ReauthenticationRequired on cold restart.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-406: Persistence boundary test confirms zero password/MD5 on disk and safe restart reauthentication.

acceptance_criteria.description: Specification defines governed T4 transition delta for AndroidManifest.xml (INTERNET only) and mode-scoped apk_validator.py preserving non-waivable security checks.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-407, TEST-PILOT-414: Transition plan verified and enforced prior to live pilot build.

acceptance_criteria.description: Until the separate T4 transition PR is authorized, AndroidManifest.xml (INTERNET-free) and policies/checks.json remain unmodified.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-407: Spec baseline keeps AndroidManifest.xml and policies/checks.json unchanged (7/7 checks PASS).

acceptance_criteria.description: SessionCoordinator and DeviceInventoryRepository enforce sessionEpoch isolation across pilot sign-in, user_thing_list_get, replacement, and logout.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-408: MockWebServer epoch test discards stale HTTP/WS callbacks on logout or account switch.

acceptance_criteria.description: DeviceCapabilityClassifier permits read-only live telemetry subscription strictly for verified LaserSlam (MvpSupportedShadowWs) devices.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-408, TEST-PILOT-414: Non-laser/peripheral/camera/unknown devices rejected for WS telemetry subscription.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot UI displays read-only device identity verification metadata (nickname, normalized sub_type, isAdmin, ControlCompatibility, redacted thing_name) without raw tokens.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-409: Robolectric Compose card test verifies device identity display with zero secret exposure.

acceptance_criteria.description: OkHttpWebSocketTransport enforces (sessionEpoch, connectionGeneration) fencing, active selected thing_name filtering, and read-only thing_status_update hydration.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-410, TEST-PILOT-414: MockWebServer WS test + authorized pilot observation verify bounded telemetry hydration.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot ConnectionConfig enforces bounded retries (maxReconnectAttempts <= 3, >= 4000ms delay), zero retries on 401/403/3xx, and automatic disconnect when observationWindowMs expires.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-410: Virtual-time MockWebServer test confirms 3-retry cap, auth short-circuit, and observation-window auto-disconnect.

acceptance_criteria.description: One-tap Emergency Disconnect & Wipe increments sessionEpoch, closes WS (1000), clears inventory & TokenStore, locks PilotAuthorizationGate, and restores OFFLINE SimulatorRobotTransport.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-412, TEST-PILOT-414: Kill switch integration test verifies full teardown and immediate OFFLINE reversion.

acceptance_criteria.description: ReadOnlyPilotGuard structurally blocks all outbound robot control commands (Clean, Pause, Resume, Dock, send_to_device) on live cloud transports during FCT-004.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-411: Every outbound robot command during pilot returns CommandResult.Rejected with zero live WS sends.

acceptance_criteria.description: PilotSanitizedExporter scrubs jwt_token, headers, passwords, emails, and device identifiers via SecretRedactor, and rollback to frozen FCT-003 APK is documented.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-413: Redaction export test asserts zero raw secrets/PII in captured pilot diagnostics.
